notes: skills the model can write: new skill_write and skill_delete tools let the assistant create, rewrite and remove skills from a normal chat — each one lands behind the permission prompt with the whole body visible and the tool card shows a unified diff; the skill editor in Settings > Skills gains a "Draft with the model" box that streams a first draft (or a rewrite of the skill you are editing) straight into the instructions, with Stop and Revert draft; anything the model writes keeps its previous version, so a skill card offers Revert; a skill still cannot be named after a system command, now enforced everywhere; a diff of a newly created file no longer opens with a phantom "-" line
